PUSH RULE 7 (learned S6, keep regardless): always build a theme-file body with json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=True) so every non-ASCII character travels as an explicit \uXXXX escape. A hand-typed U+00A0 in the comparison heading was silently flattened to a plain space on one push; check_template.py could not catch it because the guard runs against the candidate on disk, not against what goes over the wire. Only the checksumMd5 verify catches this, so that verify is never optional. 2026-09-21 (S6c) PERMANENTLY CLOSED - WHAT THE HOME HERO IS FOR. Hamish, in his own words: 'Mine is clwarer, i dont care if cta is not in cold, people should look at my home page and tell why I exist , mine has ebwbrow , a conplete sitting system, etc.' The home page's job is to make a stranger understand why SitComfort exists. Not worth four pages for a gap size. If the gap is ever closed, the way to do it is the proven opt-in pattern (new image_picker settings guarded by != blank, like two_up_desktop on feature-highlight), NOT raw markup.
